description: This source file implements functionality related to Git hooks management, including locating hooks, verifying their existence, and running hooks with specific options. It defines functions to find hooks in a repository, run hooks with various configurations, and handle hook execution lifecycle events.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Finds the hook script file in the specified repository by name, accounting for executable permissions and optional extension stripping.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a specific hook exists in the repository by attempting to locate it.

methods.name: int pick_next_hook(struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Prepares and initiates execution of the next hook in the sequence by setting up child process parameters.

methods.name: int notify_start_failure(struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles failure to start a hook process, updating return codes accordingly.

methods.name: int notify_hook_finished(int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the completion of a hook process, recording its result and updating invocation flags.

methods.name: void run_hooks_opt_clear(struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Clears environment and argument vectors in the run hooks options structure.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Runs hooks with specified options, handling hook location, execution, and cleanup.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)
